title: BurnoutGuardian
description: Playtime fatigue guard with breaks, mini-games and rewards.
body:
# BurnoutGuardian

Playtime fatigue guard with breaks, mini-games and rewards.

## Features
- Tracks continuous playtime and activity with AFK detection.
- Progressive fatigue stages with potion effects and encouragement.
- Relaxing mini-games: fishing challenge and calm walk.
- Break rewards and optional soft AFK particles.
- Persistent SQLite storage for long-term tracking.

## Commands
- /burnout status
- /burnout admin reload
- /burnout admin reset <player>

## Permissions
- burnoutguardian.use
- burnoutguardian.admin

## Screenshots
- Add screenshots here.

## Installation
1. Download the jar from Modrinth.
2. Put it in the server `plugins` folder.
3. Start the server to generate `config.yml`.
